name: Frog Grog
review:
A witch's brew on 23 lines, with wild frogs, a mystery game and a multiplier that keeps increasing. The bubbling-cauldron art is very charming.

Low volatility, a 1,616x cap and a 96.1% RTP. The mystery game and climbing multiplier keep things moving without big swings, so it's a good choice for long, relaxed sessions. Approachable and playful.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
